meta.description: Concrete examples for each reaction type template. R-group notation replaced with specific simple molecules. Includes both _example and _generic aliased fields for render script compatibility.

r_group_rules.X_halide: Cl or Br depending on context
r_group_rules.Base: NaOH, K2CO3, KOtBu, LDA depending on context

templates.example_notes: CH3CH2CH2-Cl (n-propyl chloride) undergoes Finkelstein exchange with NaI in acetone.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Iodide attacks n-propyl carbon; chloride departs (SN2). Classic Finkelstein in acetone.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Iodide attacks n-propyl carbon; chloride departs (SN2). Classic Finkelstein in acetone.

templates.example_notes: Ph-CH2CH2-OTs (2-phenylethyl tosylate) with KOH undergoes E2 to give styrene.

example_mechanism_steps.note: KOH removes beta-H; pi bond forms; tosylate departs (E2). Product is styrene.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: KOH removes beta-H; pi bond forms; tosylate departs (E2). Product is styrene.

templates.label_exact: Alkyl halide E2 elimination to styrene-type alkene
templates.example_notes: Ph-CH2-CH2-CH2-Br (3-phenylpropyl bromide) with KOtBu gives Ph-CH2-CH=CH2 (allylbenzene).

example_mechanism_steps.note: KOtBu abstracts beta-H; alkene forms; bromide leaves (E2). Product is allylbenzene.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: KOtBu abstracts beta-H; alkene forms; bromide leaves (E2). Product is allylbenzene.

templates.example_notes: MeMgBr opens propylene oxide (propylene oxide, CH3-epoxide) at less substituted C to give 1-butanol.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Methyl carbanion attacks less hindered epoxide carbon; ring opens; workup protonates alkoxide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Methyl carbanion attacks less hindered epoxide carbon; ring opens; workup protonates alkoxide.

templates.example_notes: Acetylacetone enolate (acetylacetonate) alkylated by ethyl bromoacetate.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate C attacks electrophilic CH2 of ethyl bromoacetate; bromide departs (SN2).

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate C attacks electrophilic CH2 of ethyl bromoacetate; bromide departs (SN2).

templates.example_notes: PhS- (thiophenolate) displaces Cl from benzyl chloride to give benzyl phenyl sulfide.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Thiolate sulfur attacks benzyl carbon; chloride departs (SN2).

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Thiolate sulfur attacks benzyl carbon; chloride departs (SN2).

templates.label_exact: Allyl ether formation from heteroaryl phenoxide
templates.example_notes: 2-Hydroxypyridine anion (2-pyridyloxide) alkylated by allyl bromide to give 2-(allyloxy)pyridine.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Pyridyloxide attacks allylic carbon; bromide leaves (SN2). Williamson allylation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Pyridyloxide attacks allylic carbon; bromide leaves (SN2). Williamson allylation.

templates.example_notes: Propargyl anion (HC≡C-) attacks allyl tosylate (CH2=CHCH2-OTs) to give pent-4-en-1-yne.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Acetylide attacks allylic carbon; tosylate departs (SN2).

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Acetylide attacks allylic carbon; tosylate departs (SN2).

templates.label_exact: Hofmann elimination of quaternary ammonium hydroxide
templates.example_notes: Trimethyl(2-methylpropyl)ammonium hydroxide (neopentyl-type) undergoes Hofmann to give isobutylene.

example_mechanism_steps.note: OH removes beta-H; pi bond forms; trimethylamine leaves (Hofmann elimination gives less substituted alkene).

generic_mechanism_steps.note: OH removes beta-H; pi bond forms; trimethylamine leaves (Hofmann elimination gives less substituted alkene).

templates.example_notes: Acetic acid (CH3CO2H) methylation with CH2N2 gives methyl acetate (CH3CO2CH3).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Proton transfer from acid to diazomethane generates ion pair intermediate.
Carboxylate attacks methyl; N2 is expelled. Product is methyl acetate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Proton transfer from acid to diazomethane generates ion pair intermediate.
Carboxylate attacks methyl; N2 is expelled. Product is methyl acetate.

templates.example_notes: Phenol (PhOH) O-methylated by diazomethane to give anisole (PhOCH3).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Phenol protonates diazomethane; phenoxide and methyldiazonium ion pair form.
Phenoxide attacks methyl; N2 expelled. Product is anisole.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Phenol protonates diazomethane; phenoxide and methyldiazonium ion pair form.
Phenoxide attacks methyl; N2 expelled. Product is anisole.

templates.label_exact: Williamson ether synthesis from phenol and alkyl iodide
templates.example_notes: Phenol + K2CO3 + ethyl iodide gives phenetole (PhOC2H5) via Williamson ether synthesis.

example_mechanism_steps.note: K2CO3 deprotonates phenol to phenoxide.
Phenoxide attacks ethyl iodide (SN2); iodide departs. Product is phenetole.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: K2CO3 deprotonates phenol to phenoxide.
Phenoxide attacks ethyl iodide (SN2); iodide departs. Product is phenetole.

templates.label_exact: SN1 hydrolysis of tertiary benzylic chloride
templates.example_notes: Ph-C(Cl)(CH3)2 (cumyl chloride) solvolysis in water gives Ph-C(OH)(CH3)2 (cumyl alcohol) via SN1.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Ionization gives resonance-stabilized benzylic/tertiary carbocation.
Water traps the carbocation to give the oxonium intermediate.
Deprotonation gives neutral cumyl alcohol.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ionization gives resonance-stabilized benzylic/tertiary carbocation.
Water traps the carbocation to give the oxonium intermediate.

templates.label_exact: Glycidyl ether formation from phenol and epichlorohydrin
templates.example_notes: Phenol + epichlorohydrin + NaOH gives phenyl glycidyl ether (2,3-epoxypropyl phenyl ether).

example_mechanism_steps.note: NaOH generates phenoxide.
Phenoxide opens epoxide at less hindered carbon; chlorohydrin intermediate.
Base deprotonates alcohol; alkoxide closes ring intramolecularly (SN2); chloride departs.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: NaOH generates phenoxide.
Phenoxide opens epoxide at less hindered carbon; chlorohydrin intermediate.
Base deprotonates alcohol; alkoxide closes ring intramolecularly (SN2); chloride departs.

templates.example_notes: Methanol + acryloyl chloride + Et3N gives methyl acrylate (CH2=CH-CO2CH3).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Methanol attacks acryloyl carbonyl; pi bond collapses to oxygen.
Carbonyl reforms; chloride departs. Methyl acrylate forms.
Triethylamine scavenges HCl.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Methanol attacks acryloyl carbonyl; pi bond collapses to oxygen.
Carbonyl reforms; chloride departs. Methyl acrylate forms.
Triethylamine scavenges HCl.

templates.example_notes: Chlorobenzene + NaNH2 (sodamide) gives aniline via benzyne intermediate.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Sodamide removes ortho-H adjacent to Cl to give aryl carbanion.
Carbanion forms strained benzyne triple-bond surrogate; Cl- expelled.
Amide adds to benzyne; sigma-complex carbanion forms.
Protonation by NH3 restores aromaticity; aniline product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Sodamide removes ortho-H adjacent to Cl to give aryl carbanion.
Carbanion forms strained benzyne triple-bond surrogate; Cl- expelled.
Amide adds to benzyne; sigma-complex carbanion forms.
Protonation by NH3 restores aromaticity; aniline product.

templates.example_notes: Benzene + HNO3/H2SO4 gives nitrobenzene (electrophilic aromatic nitration).

example_mechanism_steps.note: H2SO4 protonates nitric acid.
Water departs to generate nitronium ion (NO2+).
Benzene pi system attacks NO2+; Wheland intermediate forms.
Deprotonation restores aromaticity; nitrobenzene product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: H2SO4 protonates nitric acid.
Water departs to generate nitronium ion (NO2+).
Benzene pi system attacks NO2+; Wheland intermediate forms.
Deprotonation restores aromaticity; nitrobenzene product.

templates.label_exact: Boron enolate aldol addition to aldehyde
templates.example_notes: Dicyclohexylboron enolate of acetaldehyde adds to benzaldehyde; workup gives 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropanal.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate alpha-C attacks aldehyde carbonyl; new C-C bond forms; boron aldolate.
Alkoxide remains coordinated to boron.
Aqueous workup hydrolyzes boron-oxygen bond; beta-hydroxy aldehyde product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate alpha-C attacks aldehyde carbonyl; new C-C bond forms; boron aldolate.
Alkoxide remains coordinated to boron.
Aqueous workup hydrolyzes boron-oxygen bond; beta-hydroxy aldehyde product.

templates.label_exact: Amide formation from acid chloride and amine
templates.example_notes: Acetyl chloride + diethylamine + Et3N gives N,N-diethylacetamide.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Diethylamine attacks acetyl chloride carbonyl; pi bond shifts to O.
Carbonyl reforms; Cl departs to give acylated ammonium.
Et3N removes proton; neutral N,N-diethylacetamide product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Diethylamine attacks acetyl chloride carbonyl; pi bond shifts to O.
Carbonyl reforms; Cl departs to give acylated ammonium.
Et3N removes proton; neutral N,N-diethylacetamide product.

templates.example_notes: Ethanol + acetic anhydride + pyridine gives ethyl acetate.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Ethanol attacks one anhydride carbonyl.
Collapse reforms carbonyl; acetate departs.
Pyridine deprotonates the oxonium; neutral ester forms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ethanol attacks one anhydride carbonyl.
Collapse reforms carbonyl; acetate departs.
Pyridine deprotonates the oxonium; neutral ester forms.

templates.label_exact: Trityl ether formation for alcohol protection
templates.example_notes: 1-Propanol + TrCl (triphenylmethyl chloride) + Et3N gives propyl trityl ether.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Trityl chloride ionizes; resonance-stabilized trityl cation forms.
Propanol oxygen attacks trityl cation; oxonium ion forms.
Et3N removes proton; neutral trityl ether product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Trityl chloride ionizes; resonance-stabilized trityl cation forms.
Propanol oxygen attacks trityl cation; oxonium ion forms.
Et3N removes proton; neutral trityl ether product.

templates.example_notes: 1-Propanol + TsCl + Et3N gives n-propyl tosylate.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Propanol oxygen attacks sulfonyl S; coordination expands.
Chloride departs; alkoxy-sulfonyl cation forms.
Et3N removes proton; neutral tosylate product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Propanol oxygen attacks sulfonyl S; coordination expands.
Chloride departs; alkoxy-sulfonyl cation forms.
Et3N removes proton; neutral tosylate product.

templates.example_notes: 2-methyl-2-propanol (tert-butanol) + H2SO4 gives 2-methylpropene (isobutylene) by E1.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation of tert-butanol makes water a leaving group.
Water departs; tertiary carbocation forms.
Loss of beta-proton gives isobutylene; H+ regenerated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation of tert-butanol makes water a leaving group.

templates.example_notes: Ethylene oxide + H2O/H+ gives ethylene glycol (1,2-ethanediol).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Epoxide oxygen is protonated; ring activated for opening.
Water attacks epoxide carbon; ring opens to give 1,2-diol-oxonium.
Deprotonation gives ethylene glycol; H+ regenerated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Epoxide oxygen is protonated; ring activated for opening.
Water attacks epoxide carbon; ring opens to give 1,2-diol-oxonium.
Deprotonation gives ethylene glycol; H+ regenerated.

templates.example_notes: Cyclohexanone + Ac2O + Et3N gives 1-acetoxycyclohexene (enol acetate).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Et3N removes alpha-H from cyclohexanone; enolate forms.
Enolate oxygen attacks acetyl group of Ac2O; O-acylation.
Collapse gives enol acetate; acetate departs.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Et3N removes alpha-H from cyclohexanone; enolate forms.
Enolate oxygen attacks acetyl group of Ac2O; O-acylation.
Collapse gives enol acetate; acetate departs.

templates.label_exact: Silyl enol ether formation from ketone
templates.example_notes: Cyclohexanone + LDA + TMS-Cl gives 1-(trimethylsilyloxy)cyclohexene (TMS enol ether).

example_mechanism_steps.note: LDA deprotonates alpha position; lithium enolate forms.
Enolate O attacks Si (SN2 at Si); chloride departs; TMS enol ether.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: LDA deprotonates alpha position; lithium enolate forms.
Enolate O attacks Si (SN2 at Si); chloride departs; TMS enol ether.

templates.example_notes: Nitromethane + acetone + Et3N gives 1-nitro-2-propanol (beta-nitro alcohol) via Henry reaction.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Et3N removes acidic CH of nitromethane; nitronate anion forms.
Nitronate C attacks acetone carbonyl; new C-C bond; alkoxide forms.
Protonation gives beta-nitro alcohol product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Et3N removes acidic CH of nitromethane; nitronate anion forms.
Nitronate C attacks acetone carbonyl; new C-C bond; alkoxide forms.

templates.label_exact: Aldol addition of lithium enolate to aldehyde
templates.example_notes: LDA enolate of acetaldehyde adds to benzaldehyde to give 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropanal.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate alpha-C attacks benzaldehyde; C-C bond forms.
Product stabilized as lithium alkoxide before workup.
Aqueous workup protonates alkoxide; beta-hydroxy aldehyde isolated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate alpha-C attacks benzaldehyde; C-C bond forms.
Product stabilized as lithium alkoxide before workup.
Aqueous workup protonates alkoxide; beta-hydroxy aldehyde isolated.

templates.label_exact: Michael addition of enolate to enone
templates.example_notes: Acetylacetone enolate adds to MVK (methyl vinyl ketone) in Michael addition.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate alpha-C attacks beta-C of MVK (1,4-addition); new C-C bond.
Adduct exists as enolate resonance form.
Protonation gives neutral 1,5-dicarbonyl product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Enolate alpha-C attacks beta-C of MVK (1,4-addition); new C-C bond.

templates.example_notes: Ethyl chloroacetate + benzaldehyde + NaOEt gives ethyl 2,3-epoxyphenylpropanoate (Darzens ester).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Base removes alpha-H from ethyl chloroacetate; halo ester enolate.
Enolate attacks benzaldehyde; beta-halo alkoxide forms.
Alkoxide displaces Cl intramolecularly; glycidic ester epoxide forms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Base removes alpha-H from ethyl chloroacetate; halo ester enolate.

templates.example_notes: Ethyl acetate + NaOEt + ethyl acetate gives ethyl acetoacetate (Claisen condensation).
resulting_state_example: CH3COCH2CO2Et (ethyl acetoacetate) as enolate / after protonation

example_mechanism_steps.note: NaOEt deprotonates alpha-H of ethyl acetate; ester enolate.
Enolate attacks second ester's carbonyl; tetrahedral intermediate.
Ethoxide departs; ethyl acetoacetate product (as enolate) forms.

resulting_state_generic: CH3COCH2CO2Et (ethyl acetoacetate) as enolate / after protonation

generic_mechanism_steps.note: NaOEt deprotonates alpha-H of ethyl acetate; ester enolate.
Enolate attacks second ester's carbonyl; tetrahedral intermediate.
Ethoxide departs; ethyl acetoacetate product (as enolate) forms.

templates.label_exact: Alpha-sulfide formation from enolate and disulfide
templates.example_notes: LDA enolate of acetone reacts with dimethyl disulfide (MeSSMe) to give alpha-(methylthio)acetone.

example_mechanism_steps.note: LDA deprotonates alpha position of acetone.
Enolate C attacks one S of disulfide; S-S bond cleaves; thiolate departs.
Protonation gives neutral alpha-thioketone.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: LDA deprotonates alpha position of acetone.

templates.example_notes: Corey-Chaykovsky: trimethylsulfonium ylide + benzaldehyde gives styrene oxide.

example_mechanism_steps.note: NaH generates trimethylsulfonium methylide from trimethylsulfonium salt.
Ylide C attacks benzaldehyde C; betaine intermediate.
Alkoxide displaces Me2S intramolecularly; styrene oxide forms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: NaH generates trimethylsulfonium methylide from trimethylsulfonium salt.

templates.example_notes: Pinacol (2,3-dimethyl-2,3-butanediol) + H2SO4 gives pinacolone (3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one).

example_mechanism_steps.note: One hydroxyl is protonated by H2SO4.
Water leaves; 1,2-methyl migration gives oxocarbenium (pinacolone cation).
Deprotonation gives neutral pinacolone; H+ regenerated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: One hydroxyl is protonated by H2SO4.

templates.example_notes: 1-propanol + conc. HCl gives 1-chloropropane via SN1/SN2.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation of propanol activates it.
Water departs; carbocation (or highly activated substrate) forms.
Chloride attacks cation; 1-chloropropane product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation of propanol activates it.
Water departs; carbocation (or highly activated substrate) forms.

templates.example_notes: Acetone + Br2/AcOH gives bromoacetone (alpha-bromination).

example_mechanism_steps.note: Acid-catalyzed enolization of acetone.
Enol pi bond attacks Br2; alpha-bromo oxonium and Br- form.
Carbonyl restored by tautomerization.
Neutral bromoacetone isolated; HBr by-product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Acid-catalyzed enolization of acetone.

templates.example_notes: Dimethylamine + formaldehyde + NaBH3CN (Eschweiler-Clarke or reductive methylation) gives trimethylamine.

example_mechanism_steps.note: Dimethylamine attacks formaldehyde; carbinolamine adduct.
Proton transfer at O/N prepares for dehydration.
Water eliminated; iminium ion (CH3)2N+=CH2 forms.
Hydride from NaBH3CN reduces iminium C; trimethylammonium forms.
Deprotonation gives neutral trimethylamine.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Dimethylamine attacks formaldehyde; carbinolamine adduct.

templates.example_notes: 1,3-dimethylimidazolium salt + KOtBu gives 1,3-dimethylimidazol-2-ylidene (NHC carbene).

generic_mechanism_steps.note: KOtBu removes acidic C2-H; electron pair remains on C2 to give NHC carbene.

templates.example_notes: Sodium ethoxide + n-propyl tosylate gives n-propyl ethyl ether by SN2.

templates.example_notes: PPh3 + benzyl bromide gives benzyltriphenylphosphonium bromide (Wittig precursor).

templates.example_notes: Propene + HBr gives 2-bromopropane (Markovnikov addition).

templates.example_notes: Benzaldehyde + HCN gives mandelonitrile (PhCH(OH)CN) — cyanohydrin.

templates.example_notes: Methyl vinyl ketone (MVK) + HCN gives 5-oxohexanenitrile (4-cyano-2-butanone).

templates.label_exact: Conjugate hydrogen halide addition to enone
